title: <tool>.json
description: A tool's record, read by the rbtv installer.

name.description: The tool's name, the same as its folder.

description.description: One line that is enough for an agent to decide whether to use the tool.

entry.description: The program file the installer places on PATH, written with forward slashes, relative to the tool's folder and inside its component; or, with the prefix `ws:`, a program in another repository of the installation, relative to the installation root. It starts with a shebang line or ends in .py, .js, or .sh, so every operating system can run it. The command's name on PATH is the tool's name.
